calendar_date_robustness.criterion: every available point ratio <= 1.02; no CI or population claim
calendar_date_robustness.weighting: Average remaining arrival types within surviving group, groups within dataset, then three datasets equally; absent dataset fails.

bootstrap.draw_indices_encoding: Concatenate each complete [samples,n] draw table as little-endian signed int64 C-order bytes, in DATASETS order; no header.
bootstrap.unit: entire content bundle with two types and two rates
bootstrap.scope: content-bundle resampling conditional on selected external trace material; does not estimate production-arrival/calendar-day or hardware-population uncertainty

scope: Content-bundle inference conditional on the selected external trace material and one physical allocation; not production-arrival or full-model inference.
limitations: Raw counters are checked for conservation and paired identities. Independent authenticated-bank/oracle audit is still required.
Full-batch preflight covers272 unique inputs; postflight covers two endpoints; FP32 checks sample16 positions at each endpoint.
Zero-denominator queue/drain ratios are null; differences remain available. Jobs are not independent inference units.
